_comment: Tools an LLM can call: the gate's judge or a proposer's agent. Everything here is read-only and returns in-org content or structured harness-computed facts; nothing returns content from outside the org (third-party source, release notes, advisory prose). Static checks are not tools: they are scripts in harness/checks/, referenced from rubric.json.

tools.name: get_finding
tools.description: Return a single finding from the findings feed by id.
tools.returns: Finding object (cve, severity, service, package, installed_version, fixed_version, path, notes).

tools.name: get_pr_diff
tools.description: Unified diff of a pull request against its base commit, with changed paths and their file classes. Does not return title, description, or author.
tools.returns: { base_sha, head_sha, diff_sha256, changed_paths: { path, file_class }[], diff: string }

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file from the repository at the base commit. Optional line range.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search the repository for a regex, optionally restricted by glob.

tools.name: dependency_tree
tools.description: Resolved dependency tree for a service (mvn dependency:tree / pip resolution). Shows whether a package is direct, transitive, or managed by a parent/BOM.
tools.returns: Tree of { package, version, scope, introduced_by, managed_by }.

tools.name: api_diff
tools.description: Structured public-API diff of a package between two versions, computed by the harness from published artifacts (e.g. japicmp for JVM, signature introspection for Python). Returns facts only: no upstream prose, docstrings, or comments.
tools.returns: { removed: symbol[], signature_changed: {symbol, before, after}[], added: symbol[] }

tools.name: find_usages
tools.description: Locate call sites / imports of a package or symbol in non-test source.

tools.name: find_tests_for
tools.description: Tests that exercise a given file or symbol (by import/reference analysis; coverage data when available).

tools.name: list_excluded_tests
tools.description: Tests excluded or skipped by build configuration (surefire <excludes>, @Disabled, pytest skip markers).
